smooth OFX plugin — Release Notes
=================================

Version      : 1.6.0
Release date : 2026-05-05 (macOS), 2026-05-08 (Windows / Linux)
Platforms    : macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon), macOS x86_64 (Intel),
               Windows x64, Linux x86-64 (RHEL-9 family, glibc 2.34+)
Signed       : Ad hoc on macOS, NOT notarized; Windows / Linux unsigned
               (Linux OFX hosts do not require code signing)

This release aligns the OFX-port version line with the AE-side fork
hiroshisaito/smooth v1.6.0. There were no OFX 1.5.x releases (the
1.5.x line was AE-side only); 1.6.0 picks up where OFX 1.4.0 left off.

Highlights vs 1.4.0:
  * 8-bit and 32-bit float paths now run through the smooth_core Rust
    crate (rayon strip-parallel internally). Output is byte-identical
    to 1.4.0; wall-clock is 2.5x-3.1x faster on multi-core hosts at
    1080p/4K.
  * 16-bit integer keeps the C++ implementation for now (smooth_core's
    Pixel16 max is 0x8000, OFX's is 0xFFFF).
  * Effect Controls now show a read-only "build" label with the plugin
    version + git short SHA + Rust core build id, so UAT can confirm
    at a glance which build is loaded.

OpenFX port of the "smooth" plugin, originally released by LOILO Inc.
as an After Effects plugin. Verified on DaVinci Resolve on macOS, Windows,
and Linux (host_smoke reports the canonical pure0=562 / pureMax=562 /
intermediate=924 across all three pixel depths on every platform).


Release artifacts
-----------------

Per-platform single-arch builds; pick the one that matches your host:

  * smooth-1.6.0-macos-arm64.zip    — Apple Silicon (M1 / M2 / M3 / M4 …)
  * smooth-1.6.0-macos-x86_64.zip   — Intel Macs
  * smooth-1.6.0-windows-x64.zip    — Windows 10 / 11 x64
                                      (built with VS 18 2026 + Rust 1.94)
  * smooth-1.6.0-linux-x86-64.tar.gz — RHEL-9 family x86_64
                                      (Rocky Linux 9.5, glibc 2.34+)

Each archive contains smooth.ofx.bundle (single-arch), a per-platform
README.txt, and this RELEASE-NOTES.txt.

SHA-256 digests are provided alongside each archive as .sha256 files.


Install
-------

See the per-platform README.txt bundled inside each archive for
step-by-step instructions.

macOS (summary):
  1. Unzip, copy smooth.ofx.bundle to /Library/OFX/Plugins/
  2. sudo xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Library/OFX/Plugins/smooth.ofx.bundle
  3. Restart DaVinci Resolve -> Effects -> Filters -> Smooth

Windows (summary):
  1. Unzip, copy smooth.ofx.bundle to
     C:\Program Files\Common Files\OFX\Plugins\
  2. Restart DaVinci Resolve -> Effects -> Filters -> Smooth

Linux (summary):
  1. Untar, copy smooth.ofx.bundle to /usr/OFX/Plugins/ (or the host's
     dedicated plugin directory, e.g. Resolve's
     /var/BlackmagicDesign/DaVinci Resolve/Support/OFX/Plugins/)
  2. Restart DaVinci Resolve -> Effects -> Filters -> Smooth


What was in 1.4.0 (carried into 1.6.0)
--------------------------------------

Added
  * OpenFX 1.5.1 plugin implementation (jp.loilo.smooth, version 1.4).
  * Pixel-depth support: 8-bit integer, 16-bit integer, 16-bit float,
    and 32-bit float RGBA working color spaces.
  * Premultiplied-alpha handling: input is unpremultiplied before the
    smoothing pass and re-premultiplied on output, so Resolve / Fusion
    produce correct edges.
  * Parameters: range (0..100, default 1.0), lineWeight (0..1, default 0.0),
    whiteOption / transparent (boolean).
  * macOS arm64 and x86_64 per-architecture builds, deployment target 11.0,
    proper smooth.ofx.bundle with generated Info.plist.
  * Windows x64 build via MSVC 2019+ or MSYS2 MinGW-w64.
  * Minimal OFX host harness (tests/host_smoke.cpp) for smoke testing
    without a full host.

Fixed
  * Black-pixel artifact on lines in 16/32-bit float color spaces.
    Root cause: int accumulator truncating float pixel values.
  * White-fringe artifact on transparent edges under DaVinci Resolve
    when the transparent option was on. Root cause: algorithm assumed
    straight RGBA; now unpremult/premult are handled.


Known limitations
-----------------

  * Tile rendering is not supported.
  * Multi-resolution / proxy rendering is not verified.
  * GPU render path is not implemented (CPU only).
  * macOS release zips are ad hoc signed but NOT notarized. Gatekeeper
    may still block first load. Remove the quarantine attribute before
    loading:
      sudo xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine \
        /Library/OFX/Plugins/smooth.ofx.bundle


Checksums
---------

  * dist/smooth-1.6.0-macos-arm64.zip.sha256
  * dist/smooth-1.6.0-macos-x86_64.zip.sha256
  * dist/smooth-1.6.0-windows-x64.zip.sha256
  * dist/smooth-1.6.0-linux-x86-64.tar.gz.sha256
